notable_absence.finding: Storage engine choice never appears in this page's creation procedure at all. Step 10 covers Free/Single Node/Multi-Node/Custom sizing (compute, storage amount, IOPS) but never mentions Couchstore or Magma. This directly tests this batch's hypothesis: the authoritative cluster-creation flow does NOT confirm storage-engine as a cluster-creation-time choice - it appears nowhere on this page. See databases.json for where it does appear (only as a bucket-level metric name inside a guardrail threshold table), which suggests storage-engine:couchstore/magma may actually be a bucket-level setting, not a cluster-level one, making the clusters/ namespace the wrong home for it. Flagging for reconciler; not re-minting or moving it myself since bucket-creation pages (data-service/manage-buckets.md) are out of this batch's scope.

cross_component_finding: This page explicitly excludes free-tier clusters ('This section does not apply to Capella free tier operational clusters') and directs them to a separate creation flow (get-started/create-account.md). So plan:free-tier-plan is NOT one of the Support Plan choices offered by this procedure, even though it's part of the four-tier plan family - free tier clusters are created and support-planned through an entirely different flow than paid clusters.
